competitorGap.reason: Breville support pages list the empty-tank and not-seated causes and the rinse-refill step, and coffeeblog covers the normal cycle. A combined fault tree is only partly missing.

commercialFit.reason: Repair vs replace is a real decision, but descaler and replacement machine are weak links to the actual fault.

overlap.reason: It overlaps heavily with the archived 'Bambino Plus cleaning vs descaling: which cycle do the lights mean?' post.
